'''Star Tours Flight 716''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was cancelled before its scheduled 1220 hours arrival at the spaceport's Gate 2F. It would have then departed at 1315.
